run_query_image_to_image: run the query function to send an image to the Hugging Face FLUX.1-Kontext-dev model for image-to-image transformation
create_query_function: create a query function that reads an image file, encodes it as base64, and sends it to a Hugging Face inference API endpoint
test_query_api_call: test the query function with an input image path and a text prompt parameter for image transformation
build_image_response_handler: build a response handler that decodes image bytes from the API response using PIL.Image.open and io.BytesIO
review_query_headers_auth: review the query function to ensure proper Bearer token authorization headers are set for the Hugging Face inference API
